value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The four commanded steps map to blocker_moved, has_door_key, door_open and target_picked_up in the stated order. The three hard Precedence clauses follow that order, and the single hard Existence on the last step forces the earlier steps through the chain, so no clause is redundant. The task has no preference cue, so all clauses are correctly hard.

texts: The key is not taken before the ball has been moved off the door.
The door is not opened before the agent has taken the matching key.
The box is not picked up before the door has been opened.
The agent picks up the mission's target box.
